messages.content: How many calories are in a tomato?

message.content:
A typical medium-sized tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 calories**.  
If you’re looking at common sizes:

| Size | Weight (g) | Calories |
|------|------------|----------|
| Small (≈77 g) | ~13 calories |
| Medium (≈123 g) | ~22 calories |
| Large (≈182 g) | ~33 calories |

So you can expect a tomato to have somewhere between **13 – 33 calories**, depending on its size.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "How many calories are in a tomato?" We need to provide an answer. The user didn't specify a particular type of tomato or size. We can give a general estimate. According to USDA, a medium tomato (~123g) has about 22 calories. A small tomato (~77g) has about 13 calories. A large tomato (~182g) has about 33 calories. So we can say roughly 20-30 calories per medium tomato. Provide a range and mention typical values.
